answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 61359 Country: India Title: qarz Question: Can a person take qarz from a person whose earning is haram? Will that money be halal for the person who takes qarz? Please explain your answer with reference to the Holy Quran and Hadith. Answer ID: 61359 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 832/797/SN=11/1436) It is not lawful for you to borrow money from such a person you know that he is giving you qarz from the amount earned through unlawful source. Likewise it is also not lawful to take money from such a person who has both halal and haram income and the quantity of haram is more and both (halal and haram) are so mixed that cannot be separated from each other. (See: Fatawa Darul Uloom, 15/55, Mal-e-Haram Ke Sharai Ahkam, p. 142, Fatawa Mahmoodia 18/454, pub. Dhabel) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
